title: Email Verification Notice
description: Initial verification screen requiring email confirmation before entering workspace.
friction: External email dependency before product access.

title: Sign In / Product Capabilities Overview
description: Hero screen highlighting Zorvi features (AI Generation, Multi-brand, Remotion video, Pitch decks).
friction: Standard sign-in credentials entry.

title: User Credentials Entry
description: User entering credentials (vhp1535@gmail.com).
friction: Manual form completion.

title: Goal: What do you want to create?
description: Wizard Step 1: Broad focus selection (Social Media, Blog Content, Video Content, Everything).
friction: Selecting Everything triggers an overwhelming deluge of sub-questions.

title: More Details: Granular Deliverables
description: Step 2: 15+ checkboxes across Social Platforms, Blog Types, and Video Types.
friction: High cognitive load; forces user to configure sub-options too early.

title: Account Type: How will you be working?
description: Step 3: Personal (Solo creator), Company (Team), Agency (Multiple clients).
friction: Separate screen for a 1-click question that could be merged.

title: About You: What is your role?
description: Step 4: Role selection (Business Owner, Marketing Manager, Content Creator, Founder, HR, Other).
friction: Another separate qualification screen before experiencing the app.

title: Team Size: Scale of organization
friction: Redundant organizational scale question right after account type and role.

title: Current Tools: Competitor Ecosystem
description: Step 6: 18 tool badges (Buffer, Hootsuite, ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, etc.) plus search/add.
friction: Market research survey for internal company benefit, zero value for the user.

title: Create Brand: URL Input
description: Step 7: Enter website URL (zorvi.ai) for automatic AI extraction.
friction: Requires manual URL input and triggers heavy synchronous scraper.

title: Brand Analysis: Connecting & Screenshot
description: Step 8: AI connects to website; displays Estimated time remaining: 3m 0s.
friction: SEVERE BLOCKER: User forced to wait 1-3 minutes looking at a progress bar.

title: Brand Analysis: Colors & Font Extraction
description: Step 8: Extracts screenshot, colors, and typography.
friction: Notice: This usually takes 1-2 minutes. Over 50% abandonment here.

title: Brand Voice & Typography Review
description: Step 9: Review Plus Jakarta Sans fonts, 7 voice tones, and 10 adjective tags.
friction: Massive administrative form presented before creating any content.

title: Extracted Products & Services Review
description: Step 9: Review extracted Starter Plan (/mo), Pro Plan, and service tiers.
friction: Unnecessary upfront complexity for content creation workflows.

title: Brand Creation Confirmation
description: Step 9: Finalize brand confirmation button (Looks Good! Create Brand).
friction: Still stuck at 73% progress despite completing brand setup.

title: Audience Quiz Q1/10: TikTok Demographics
description: Step 10: Age range on TikTok (13-17, 18-24, 25-34, Other).
friction: SURVEY FATIGUE: Beginning of a 10-question sequential survey.

title: Audience Quiz Q2/10: Instagram Reels Format
description: Step 10: Preferred Reels content (Entertainment, Educational, Trends, Tutorials).
friction: Repetitive platform-by-platform interrogation.

title: Audience Quiz Q3/10: LinkedIn Style
description: Step 10: Content style on LinkedIn (Insights, Industry news, Company updates).
friction: User feels trapped in a never-ending questionnaire.

title: Audience Quiz Q4/10: YouTube Video Length
description: Step 10: Video duration preferences (<1m, 1-3m, 4-10m, 10m+).
friction: Progress bar remains frozen at 82%.

title: Audience Quiz Q5/10: Blog Reading Time
description: Step 10: When do you usually read blogs? (Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Late night).
friction: Irrelevant question for drafting business copy.

title: Audience Quiz Q6/10: Twitter Follow Motivations
description: Step 10: Motivation to follow brands (Informative, Engaging, Customer service).
friction: Feels like academic market research.

title: Audience Quiz Q7/10: SaaS on Facebook Frustrations
description: Step 10: Bizarre auto-generated question about SaaS pain points on Facebook.
friction: High confusion and low relevance.

title: Audience Quiz Q8/10: Medium Article Preferences
description: Step 10: Deep dive articles, Listicles, Opinion pieces, How-to guides.
friction: Yet another reading preference question.

title: Audience Quiz Q9/10: Threads Content Style
description: Step 10: Casual discussions, In-depth analysis, Quick updates.
friction: Redundant with Twitter/X question.

title: Persona Generation Loading Screen
description: Step 10: Building your audience personas (Progress: 60%).
friction: Another spinner delaying the user.

title: Audience Personas Review
description: Step 11: Young Marketing Professionals and Lifestyle Bloggers cards.
friction: Abstract persona cards shown with no content attached.

title: Content Strategy & Calendar Review
description: Step 12: Blog Insights for B2B Tech Decision Makers cards.
friction: Progress bar still stuck at 82% after 8+ minutes.

title: Invite Team Members Screen
description: Step 13: Invite teammates by email before seeing product value.
friction: Premature virality ask. Users refuse to invite peers before verifying tool.

title: Arrival on Zorvi Home Dashboard
description: Empty dashboard with zero drafts, zero review, zero published.
friction: EMPTY STATE SHOCK: No dopamine or pre-generated content waiting.

title: Dashboard Tour 1/9: AI Briefing Tooltip
description: Create your first piece of content modal over dashboard.
friction: 9-step modal obstacle course right after a 9-minute onboarding.

title: Dashboard Tour 2/9: Agent Library Highlight
description: Popover pointing to Agent Library in sidebar.
friction: Passive tooltip tour.

title: Dashboard Tour 4/9: Content Tools Section
description: Popover highlighting Content management in sidebar.
friction: Repetitive sidebar explanations.

title: Final Workspace State (Zorvi AI v1.7.0)
description: Complete Zorvi UI with sidebar, content pipeline, upcoming publishes, plans.
friction: User has spent nearly 10 minutes and still has 0 active drafts in pipeline.
